Both OPEC and the IEA have CUT their 2026 demand outlooks, so the bid is supply-fear, not demand. 166.80 is 5.4% below the 176.41 52wk high but 55% above the 107.68 low — energy has already re-rated hard this year. Went ex-dividend 8/17, so no yield support inside the hold.
positions.driver: Tier 2: Brent +1.5% to $93.01 on Strait of Hormuz vessel attacks
